rows.en: Please find and collect the containers.
Find and collect the containers.
Hey, collect the containers!
Find and collect the containers.
Collect the containers.
Please prioritize securing the containers.
Secure the containers first.
Collecting containers is a proper job too, you know!
Prioritize securing the containers.
Your mission is to collect the containers.
Please hurry and collect the containers.
Collect the containers quickly.
Collect the containers before anything else!
Containers, hurry!
Hurry with the containers.
Please collect as many containers as you can in time.
Collect as many containers as you can before time's up.
Collect as many containers as you can. As many as you CAN, mind you.
Get as many containers as you can.
Collect as many containers as you can.
Collect the containers at the designated position.
rows.notes: Could also mean bring the containers to the designated position; the Japanese is not clear. Kept the same reading for all five.

rows.en: Collect the containers at the designated position.
Collect the containers at the designated spot!
Get the containers at the marked spot.
Collect the containers at the designated position. Hurry!
Please collect the remaining containers too.
Collect the remaining containers too, please.
Good! Keep it up and collect the remaining containers.
Collect the remaining containers too.
There are still containers left. Collect as many as you can.
Please be careful not to destroy the containers.
Be careful not to destroy the containers.
Don't you dare let the containers get destroyed!
Be careful not to destroy the containers.
Honestly! Do it right!
The containers have been destroyed.
The containers were destroyed!
You hack! Letting the containers get destroyed!
The containers were destroyed.
The containers are getting destroyed!
The operation is over. Please return immediately.
Operation complete. Return now.
The operation's a succe-nyo... I bit my tongue...
rows.notes: Pinon flubs her own line; kept the stumble.

rows.en: Operation over. Return immediately.
The operation is a success! Good work!
The operation was a success. Good work.
Operation successful. Good work.
Looks like the operation was a success.
Operation successful. Good work.
Good work. It seems that went well.
You did it! The operation is a success.
You did it! The operation is over.
I'll give you credit for pulling it off.
You did it! Operation over.
Operation over. All units, return.
The operation continues. Please don't let your guard down.
Operation ongoing. Stay sharp.
The operation isn't over. Don't relax!
The operation continues. Don't get careless.
Operation ongoing. Wait for further orders.
I'm sorry, but the operation has failed.
Operation failed. Retreat.
The operation failed. You hack!
Unfortunately, the operation has failed.
Operation failed. Return to base for now. I repeat, return to base for now.
The operation has failed. Please retreat.
What a shame. The operation has failed.
A failure... You really let me down.
Operation failed. Retreat.
The operation failed... of all things.
Operation failed... No way...
Operation failed? How could this be...
How the hell did you fail?
To think the operation failed...
The operation failed. What a disaster.
The detached unit has achieved its objective. Please join up.
The detached unit achieved its objective. Join up with them.
The detached unit's achieved its objective. Join up!
rows.notes: Transcript says betsu-dotai (another torso); surely betsu-doutai (detached unit), as the others say.

rows.en: Detached unit achieved its objective. Join up.
The detached unit has completed its operation. Rendezvous with them.

row 523: Pinon flubs her own line; kept the stumble.
